tools.name: find_meeting_overlap
tools.description: Given 2-5 IANA time zones (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo), a local working window applied in every zone (default 09:00-17:00) and up to 7 calendar days, returns up to 5 ranked meeting slots in UTC with each zone's local time, UTC offset and abbreviation, DST-aware, plus an optiona

tools.name: search_timezones
tools.description: Look up IANA time zone ids by city, country, alias or a raw IANA id (e.g. "tokyo", "india", "PST"). Returns up to 5 matches; with a date, also each zone's UTC offset and abbreviation on that day. Read-only. Same engine as GET /v1/zones/search on the free BASIC plan.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_meeting_overlap · Public sink: find_meeting_overlap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_meeting_overlap · Public sink: find_meeting_overlap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
